mapper.select: SELECT dept_cd, dept_nm, DATE_FORMAT(reg_dt, "%Y-%m-%d") AS reg_dt FROM DEPT
SELECT dept_sub_cd, dept_sub_nm, dept_cd, DATE_FORMAT(reg_dt, "%Y-%m-%d") AS reg_dt FROM DEPT_SUB

SELECT U.USER_ID, U.NAME, U.MAIL, U.ADDRESS, U.dept_cd AS dept_cd, U.dept_sub_cd AS dept_sub_cd, D.dept_nm AS dept_nm, S.dept_sub_nm AS dept_sub_nm FROM USERS U INNER JOIN DEPT D ON U.dept_cd = D.dept_cd INNER JOIN DEPT_SUB S ON U.dept_cd = S.dept_cd AND U.dept_sub_cd = S.dept_sub_cd
